chapter: In The Mood, Rendezvous and Capitol
title: Rene Hall hears the stereo tape and urges instrumentals
summary: Played in mono, the tape sounds wrong; once heard properly Rene loves it, and he urges Fields to record instrumentals rather than vocals.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: I think we should add here that Rene had a big office, a music office in recording, music writing, copying service, in Hollywood, so he's established now.
You had sent him this material?

Yeah, and I called him up, I said Rene, what did you think about the material? He said what's wrong with your band, I don't know you to have a band like that, how that sounds. I just can't get any kind of sound out of it, I don't know what's going on there and I went on and said I can't understand and I went on to name some of the guys. Rene said I had some pretty nice guys in the band and
he said we'll check, you'll see what I'm talking about when you get here.

So when we went to L.A., he took me to the studio to see what he was talking about and when they played it he pointed and (inaudible). So I said what kind of machine are you playing it on and he went on to say mono and I said this is in stereo (inaudible).
Then he made some studio where he could do it and we went on then and played and Rene just flipped over it.

I had a couple of vocal numbers on there, I think I had something on Ann Walls there and he said now, you do what you want, Ernie, but you know you've had one of the greatest vocalists--he was talking about Melvin--but he said I think what you need to do is get some of this instrumental, he said you got some nice instrumental numbers here, but get some of this instrumental (inaudible). He said you'd be
smarter maybe if you recorded it alone, but as far as you let it be just Ernie Fields.
Yes, because a vocalist is independent of the bandleader.
So the way the time was, he said he'll take time, we'll do it as I see how you have something. I said yes, as long as I have a band I'm going to have something.
